name: servo
description_en: Servo aims to empower developers with a lightweight, high-performance alternative for embedding web technologies in applications.
readme_excerpt: The Servo Parallel Browser Engine Project Servo is a prototype web browser engine written in the Rust language. It is currently developed on 64-bit macOS, 64-bit Linux, 64-bit Windows, 64-bit OpenHarmony, and Android. Servo welcomes contribution from everyone. Check out: - The Servo Book for documentation - servo.org for news and guides Coordination of Servo development happens: - Here in the Github Issues - On the Servo Zulip - In video calls advertised in the Servo Project repo.
